name: Daily Invoices Report
query:
SELECT
    `tabPatient Encounter`.branch as "Clinic (Branch)",  
    `tabSales Invoice`.name as "Invoice Number:Link/Sales Invoice",
    `tabSales Invoice`.posting_date as "Invoice Date",
    `tabSales Invoice`.status as "Document Status",
    `tabSales Invoice`.encounter as "Patient Encounter:Link/Patient Encounter:120",
    `tabPatient Encounter`.patient as "Patient Name",
    `tabPatient Encounter`.patient_uhid as "Patient UHID",
    `tabPatient Encounter`.mode_of_payment as "Mode of Payment",
    SUBSTRING_INDEX(`tabPatient Encounter`.clinic, "-", 1) as "Patient Clinic", 
    `tabPayment Entry`.name as "Payment Entry Receipt:Link/Payment Entry:120",  
    SUBSTRING_INDEX(`tabPayment Entry`.mode_of_payment, "-", 1) as "Receipt Mode",    
    
    CASE
        WHEN `tabPatient Encounter`.mode_of_payment != "Insurance" AND COUNT(`tabPayment Entry`.name) OVER(PARTITION BY `tabSales Invoice`.name) > 1 THEN  "Multipay"
        WHEN `tabPatient Encounter`.mode_of_payment = "Insurance" AND `tabPayment Entry`.mode_of_payment != "Insurance" AND
            COUNT(`tabPayment Entry`.name) OVER(PARTITION BY `tabSales Invoice`.name) > 2 THEN  "Multipay" 
        WHEN `tabPatient Encounter`.mode_of_payment = "Insurance" AND `tabPayment Entry`.mode_of_payment != "Insurance" THEN "Copay"
        WHEN `tabPatient Encounter`.mode_of_payment = "Insurance" AND `tabPayment Entry`.mode_of_payment = "Insurance" THEN "Insurance"
        WHEN `tabPatient Encounter`.mode_of_payment = "Insurance" AND `tabPayment Entry`.mode_of_payment = "Insurance" AND COUNT(`tabPayment Entry`.name) OVER(PARTITION BY `tabSales Invoice`.name) > 1 THEN "Insurance"
        WHEN `tabPatient Encounter`.mode_of_payment IS NULL AND `tabPayment Entry`.mode_of_payment = "Insurance" AND COUNT(`tabPayment Entry`.name) OVER(PARTITION BY `tabSales Invoice`.name) > 1 THEN "Insurance"
        WHEN `tabPayment Entry`.mode_of_payment IS NULL THEN `tabPatient Encounter`.mode_of_payment  
        ELSE "Cash" END  as "Purpose", 
        
    COUNT(`tabPayment Entry`.name) OVER(PARTITION BY `tabSales Invoice`.name) as "No of Payments",                                                                                         
    CASE
	    WHEN `tabPayment Entry`.mode_of_payment != "Insurance" THEN `tabPayment Entry`.total_allocated_amount
	    WHEN `tabPayment Entry`.mode_of_payment IS NULL THEN `tabPayment Entry`.total_allocated_amount
	    END AS "Allocated",      
    `tabPayment Entry`.reference_no as "Payment Reference",
    `tabPayment Entry`.party_name as "Paying For",
    `tabSales Invoice`.default_insurance as "Ins Category (Scheme)",
    `tabSales Invoice`.membership_no as "Member No", 
    `tabSales Invoice`.principal_member_name as "Member Name", 
    `tabSales Invoice`.insurance_outpatient_company_name as "Outpatient Insurance",
    CASE
	    WHEN `tabPayment Entry`.mode_of_payment = "Insurance" THEN `tabPayment Entry`.paid_amount
	    WHEN `tabPatient Encounter`.mode_of_payment like "Insurance" OR `tabSales Invoice`.default_insurance IS NOT NULL AND `tabSales Invoice`.outstanding_amount > 0 THEN `tabSales Invoice`.outstanding_amount      
    END AS "To Be Paid By Insurance",
    /*CASE WHEN `tabPatient Encounter`.mode_of_payment like "Insurance" OR `tabSales Invoice`.default_insurance IS NOT NULL
        THEN `tabSales Invoice`.outstanding_amount END as "Insurance Balance",*/
    `tabSales Invoice`.grand_total as "Bill Total",
    `tabSales Invoice`.outstanding_amount as "Bill Balance" 

FROM 
    `tabSales Invoice` 
    
LEFT JOIN 
    `tabPatient Encounter` ON `tabSales Invoice`.encounter = `tabPatient Encounter`.encounter_number
    
LEFT JOIN 
    `tabPayment Entry Reference` ON `tabSales Invoice`.name = `tabPayment Entry Reference`.reference_name 
    
LEFT JOIN 
    `tabPayment Entry` ON `tabPayment Entry Reference`.parent = `tabPayment Entry`.name
    
WHERE 
    `tabSales Invoice`.status = "Paid" AND `tabSales Invoice`.posting_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s AND `tabPayment Entry`.status != "Cancelled"
